newsitem.title: UK: Friends Provident new business rises 73 percent.
newsitem.headline: Friends Provident new business rises 73 percent.

text.p: British mutual insurer Friends Provident on Tuesday reported a 73-percent increase in new business for the first six months of the year.
New business rose to 552.2 million stg in the half-year to June 30 from 318.7 million stg in the same period last year.
Retail new business increased 68 percent to 459.5 million stg while institutional business more than doubled to 92.7 million stg from 44.6 million stg last year.

Chief executive Keith Satchell said growth in both retail financial services and asset management operations reflected the success of its multi-channel distribution strategy and overall investment performance.
Independent financial adviser sales (IFA) rose 50 percent over the period.
